notes: encoding::hex: Go's Encode/Decode/Append*/Dump/Dumper and error values, differential-checked by tools/hex_check.py

Decode.note: appends to a Vec instead of filling a sized slice; bytes before a malformed byte are kept, as in Go

DecodeString.note: decode_into keeps the bytes decoded before an invalid byte, as Go returns them

Encode.note: appends to a Vec instead of filling a sized slice

InvalidByteError.Error.note: the Display impl gives Go's 'encoding/hex: invalid byte: U+XXXX' message; checked by tools/hex_check.py
